sections.Profile:
Creature from the Black Lagoon, released by Bally in December 1992, is a four-player licensed game designed by John Trudeau. At a drive-in movie theater about to play the Universal film, two young lovers on a date are sent into the movie, where the Creature carries off the girl and the player rescues her at the Snack Bar during multiball, while a hologram of the Creature lights up beneath the playfield.
